messages:
carmen: Quick Q  manager just asked for an off-cycle promo for someone who joined via acquisition 3 months ago. They're asking to combine a title bump, comp reprice, and retro grant alignment. Any special docs or exception steps?
gabe: Welcome to the chaos :) Short answer: combine evidence + acquisition context. We need clear role expansion examples and why this wasn't handled in onboarding comp. @tess for signoff chain.
tess: For acquisitions we allow exceptions but require: 1) manager rationale for timing, 2) 2-3 concrete examples of new scope vs original role, 3) comp ops signoff for repricing/grant alignment, and 4) Sr People Ops approval for off-cycle processing.
carmen: Manager has one paragraph and a verbal exec ask. Can we hand it back? Any boilerplate?
people-ops-bot: See leveling checklist: https://intra.redwood/people-ops/leveling-checklist. Use /templates/leveling-evidence.md. Required: impact summary, concrete examples with metrics, peer corroboration if available.
comp-ops: If you want grant alignment (retro or repro-rate), Comp Ops must quantify the grant and approve timing. For repricing base we need market comp data or acquisition comp note showing material change. Provide proposed new base + rationale.
gabe: Handback copy we use: "Thanks  please expand the submission with (a) 2 specific examples showing expanded scope, (b) proposed new base and grant ask, (c) attach acquisition offer paperwork or recruiter note, (d) attach any peer/internal feedback <6 months. Resubmit within 14 days."
carmen: What about evidence age? Some acquisition-era feedback is 4 months old and external. Is that okay?
tess: Prefer <6 months internal feedback. Acquisition docs and external references are ok as supplemental if you include manager attest and metrics. If most evidence is external, add extra manager examples.
comp-ops: Also note payroll/vesting cutoffs if grant timing changes. If we're moving effective across payroll cycles we'll calculate retro. Tag payroll early.
carmen: Who signs the exception? Manager claims CEO verbally approved during carve-out call.
tess: Approval = Manager + Sr People Ops partner + Compensation. Exec verbal is context but we need written approval in the Promo Portal or an attached email. If CEO already emailed, attach it.
gabe: I'll DM payroll and comp-ops for cutoff windows and post back. Carmen, ask manager to use the handback text and resubmit.
carmen: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
